overall_goal: Prepare, weigh, and log nutritional values for various vegetables and heat olive oil in a wok.

goals.description: Clean up garlic and organize the kitchen counter.
goals.rationale: The person wipes garlic pieces onto a plate, discards scraps, and puts the garlic bulb away to clear the workspace.
The person retrieves cherry tomatoes, cuts them in half one by one, and places them into a metallic bowl.

goals.description: Log the nutritional values of cherry tomatoes and celery.
goals.rationale: The person uses their phone to update the nutritional information for the cherry tomatoes and the celery stalk.

goals.description: Weigh and log the nutritional value of a carrot.
goals.rationale: The person places a carrot on the kitchen scale, weighs it, and records its nutritional value in the phone app.

goals.description: Weigh and log the nutritional value of a green pepper.
goals.rationale: The person places pieces of green pepper on the scale, adjusts the measurements, and updates the nutritional value on their phone.

goals.description: Cut the edges off the green pepper.
goals.rationale: The person moves the green pepper to the cutting board and uses a knife to trim off its edges.

goals.description: Retrieve ingredients and log the nutritional value of mushrooms.
goals.rationale: The person gathers various tupperwares and a bag of mushrooms, then uses their phone to scan the barcode and record the mushrooms' nutritional value.

goals.description: Wash, dry, and slice the mushrooms.
goals.rationale: The person opens the mushroom packaging, washes the mushrooms in a colander, dries them, and slices them on the cutting board.

goals.description: Prepare the wok with olive oil and log its nutritional value.
goals.rationale: The person turns on the stove, places the wok on it, pours olive oil into a spoon to add to the wok, and logs the oil's nutritional value on their phone.
